origin: Machine-readable companion to the whole-source hourly ConstitutionalEvent triage admitted to ankitdcx/garden-swarm NEXT_RELEASE_HARDENING.md at commit f34479d50f5e0b5d8bc9c94c2f56eb549c4fb103.
human_authorization: User explicitly delegated worthy hourly-finding triage and repository updates; this authorizes candidate integration work only. Canonical promotion remains a separate human act.

deltas.title: ConstitutionalEvent cross-field coherence
deltas.change: Add machine-checkable cross-field constraints to the existing ConstitutionalEvent schema. check_result=PASS MUST imply kind=CHECK; kind=VIOLATION MUST NOT coexist with check_result=PASS. A recorded/observable event is not a blocking predicate by itself: PASS/CHECK remains eligible for ordinary flow when all other gates pass. Existing Constitution/Policy UNKNOWN and INCONCLUSIVE fail-closed semantics remain the owner; the ConstitutionalEvent binding must preserve them and MUST NOT locally guess stronger enum mappings or convert unresolved state to PASS.
deltas.do_nothing: The current schema independently enumerates kind and check_result while TEST-CON-EVT-001/002 imply a relationship. Leaving the relationship unenforced permits contradictory typed events and consumer-dependent interpretation.
tests: TEST-CON-EVT-006: PASS+CHECK recorded/observable remains eligible for ordinary flow when all other gates pass
TEST-CON-EVT-007: ConstitutionalEvent consumer cannot promote existing UNKNOWN|INCONCLUSIVE owner state to PASS

deltas.title: Separate containment admission from ConstitutionalEvent
deltas.change: A ConstitutionalEvent, VETO, VIOLATION classification, evidence_refs, containment_criteria_result, routing, severity or event existence MUST NOT itself authorize containment/restriction. Any executed containment/restriction MUST be traceably bound to a separately verified applicable authority/action/admission decision under existing scope, expiry, evidence, safety, privacy and freshness rules. Preserve ConstitutionalEvent immutability: prefer a later immutable link from the containment/action/admission artifact back to the event instead of writing later authority into the original event. Reuse the existing canonical authority/action/ContainmentAction/ExecutionAdmissionToken owner that is applicable during propagation; no competing authority source is introduced.
deltas.do_nothing: CON-EVT-003 states the separation in prose, but the current ConstitutionalEvent contract contains containment criteria/evidence/routing fields without a machine-visible proof that an executed restriction was independently authorized. A consumer can therefore conflate event metadata with authorization unless the link is made traceable.
tests: TEST-CON-EVT-008: VETO/VIOLATION + containment criteria + no valid separate authorization/action receipt => offending transition remains blocked and containment does not execute
TEST-CON-EVT-009: stale/revoked/mismatched containment authorization => no containment execution; original constitutional block remains independently effective
TEST-CON-EVT-010: valid separately authorized containment action executes only within its own authority/scope and does not mutate the original ConstitutionalEvent

deltas.title: Non-amplifying ConstitutionalEvent observability binding
deltas.change: ConstitutionalEvent observability is an authority-preserving projection, not payload-disclosure or dereference authority. Observing, routing, subscribing to or querying an event MUST NOT grant authority to read protected evidence_refs, rights context, identity data or other protected payloads. Referenced data retains its source consent, access-control, taint, minimization, confidentiality, redaction, retention and jurisdiction constraints. Event projections expose only fields authorized for the observer/purpose; separately authorized audit access remains separately scoped. Prefer an explicit Event-Service/Security/Privacy binding rather than a ConstitutionalEvent-specific duplicate privacy subsystem.
deltas.do_nothing: The source already has privacy and authority owners, but the event observability/query boundary is not explicit enough for a machine checker to prove that event visibility cannot amplify evidence/context visibility.
tests: TEST-CON-EVT-013: unauthorized subscriber receives only permitted event projection and cannot dereference protected evidence/context
TEST-CON-EVT-014: authorized auditor receives only evidence permitted by its valid scope/purpose
TEST-CON-EVT-015: event subscription/query capability cannot be exchanged for evidence-read or containment capability

hourly_findings_collapsed_as_existing_se.reason: Existing Constitution/Policy semantics already route unresolved applicability to low-authority safe state/escalation and forbid optimistic permission. The successor should make the event binding machine-resolvable rather than create another owner rule.

hourly_findings_collapsed_as_existing_se.topic: Event persistence failure must not release VETO
hourly_findings_collapsed_as_existing_se.reason: The public hardening fixture already keeps VETO BLOCK under store failure/exception. Preserve as fault-injection evidence; do not create a new owner invariant.

Existing execution contracts require authorized PREPARE, ExecutionAdmissionToken, prepare/commit barriers for external/irreversible effects, bounded partial-failure states and compensation. ConstitutionalEvent must not duplicate Process/Execution ownership.

hourly_findings_collapsed_as_existing_se.topic: Containment outcome must not release original constitutional block
hourly_findings_collapsed_as_existing_se.reason: Preserve as a test of the existing independent constitutional VETO and containment contracts rather than minting a separate state-machine owner.

hourly_findings_collapsed_as_existing_se.topic: Materially equivalent replay under fresh transition identifier
hourly_findings_collapsed_as_existing_se.reason: Existing security hardening already scans structural/causal/equivalent transition variants and existing idempotency/ActionHash/re-evaluation semantics may close the path. Add a new semantic rule only if an executable counterexample bypasses current gates.

rejected_interpretations: Any recorded ConstitutionalEvent blocks: rejected because PASS/CHECK may continue when other gates pass.
Every violation automatically freezes the agent: rejected by CON-EVT-003 and the Human source.
A ConstitutionalEvent proves guilt or intent: rejected by the owner contract.
Create a new containment authority source: rejected; reuse existing authority/action/admission ownership.

Garden_System v15.6: bind event coherence, existing unresolved-state behavior, privacy-preserving event projection and separate containment admission into existing flows
Garden_Technical v15.6: strengthen SCHEMA-92D37B160F owner contract and link to existing execution/authority and Event-Service/Privacy owners

Garden_Annexure v15.6: add CON-EVT invariants/tests for coherence, separate admission and non-amplifying observability; preserve lifecycle/persistence/atomicity/replay as applicable regression probes under existing owners
Garden_Theories v15.6: NO_CHANGE unless later reference closure identifies an affected theory binding
promotion_boundary: This delta set is proposal/candidate evidence only. It does not modify Garden v15.5 canon, create a new authority source or promote Garden v15.6. Materialization requires whole-source propagation, reference closure, applicable Compare/Reason/Proof/Evidence/AAP/ActionGate receipts, required independent review, and separate human canonical promotion.
